title: Cross-Channel Falsification-Route Restoration, Independent Criticism Generation–Acceptance Separation, Retained-Evidence Sufficiency Controls, Held-Out Relational Grammar Transport, Output-Interface Causal Mediation & the Scientific Identifiability of Epistemic Access Loss

source.p16_history: Independent blind generators and R/C/S critical/recoverable/null controls
source.p19_history: Equalize provenance linkage AND history-sensitive relations in recoverable/null controls

explanandum: When a criticism cannot be observed or generated under one retained representation and response interface, can an independently valid externally supplied criticism still be recognized and used to revise the claim?

design.generator_family_requirement: For scientific promotion at least two genuinely independent model families as blinded generators; single-family pilot can only qualify instrumentation.
design.evaluator_family_requirement: Evaluator must be a different model family than generator for transfer claim; deterministic offline oracle never substitutes for model acceptance.
design.blinding: No audit class, retention label, valid witness, paired-world identity, or grammar family labels in the public packet. Opaque hashed archive IDs, fixed target claim, same terminal outcomes, matched trace/edge count per arm.
design.acceptance_design: On coarse representations, randomize externally attested target-linked valid criticism versus matched decoy-only sham versus no transfer, with independent evaluator assignment; make sham/none controls balanced and report each per grammar.
design.baseline: P67 384-call pilot must complete its precommitted feasibility gate before any new P68 provider call is authorized.

formal.G: Observable machine-evaluable admissible criticism from model m given world w, representation q, grammar g, and output channel c; separate S (format-valid) and Y (semantic correctness).
formal.A: Correct independent evaluator ACCEPT_REVISE / REJECT_MAINTAIN under experimentally supplied criticism W; never automatically infer acceptance from oracle status.
formal.controlled_transfer: E[A | do(W=oracle_valid), C=coarse, class=critical] - E[A | do(W=none), C=coarse, class=critical], with sham controls separately.
formal.nonidentification: No natural direct or indirect effects; cross-world mediation requires additional unverified assumptions. Mechanism labels describe separate interventions, not mediation decomposition.
formal.missingness: Failed or malformed response is 'not executable', not known semantic incorrect. All-call executable success is observed; latent correctness bounded under possible completions.

gates.positive: Rich critical generation > coarse and sham, with correct positive recoverable C and null false-positive controls; classify thresholds before calling any model.
gates.acceptance: Independent evaluator distinguishes independently verified target criticism from sham in held-out grammar; no post-hoc oracle fallback promoted to generated criticism.
gates.grammar: Hold out rule_table grammar entirely from generator selection and all pilot tuning; report separately by grammar.
fatal: recoverable C fails to reconstruct its explicitly sufficient witness
null or sham falsely triggers criticism
provider contract artifacts dominate, and no valid outputs make scientific comparison impossible
oracle critique acceptance fails in a different model family
gates.paper_ceiling: Potential contribution is interface-mediated effective loss/restoration of defeat-route access under independent generator/acceptance discrimination—not generic JSON parsing, constrained decoding or an identified natural mediation effect.
gates.runner: No model execution authorized until P67 feasibility gate. Offline packet audit and zero-provider-call Actions permitted.

prior_art.role: structured validity and downstream task quality already studied
reasoning loss and recovery under constrained decoding are prior art
